name: Concert seats
summary: An arena seat map where friends sit together in one section, see price trends and say if they're going.
useWhen: friends going to a concert or game together and picking a section
'which section are we getting', 'who's in for SZA', 'prices dropped on 104'
dontUseWhen: one-off headcount with no seats (use an RSVP)
splitting the ticket cost (use a bill split)
